# coval_alert (Resource)

Manages a Coval alert definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coval_alert" "low_resolution" {
  name                = "Low Resolution Rate"
  description         = "Records an event when the resolution rate drops below the target."
  conversation_source = "SIMULATED"
  agent_ids           = [coval_agent.support.id]

  conditions = [
    {
      metric_id       = coval_metric.resolution.id
      aggregation     = "RUN_AVERAGE"
      operator        = "LT"
      threshold_float = 0.9
    }
  ]

  # Evaluation-only alerts do not require a notification channel.
  channels = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (Dynamic) Non-empty list of public API condition objects. Supported aggregations are SINGLE, RUN_AVERAGE, RUN_FRACTION, JOB_SUCCESS, and BASELINE_DEVIATION.
- `name` (String) Human-readable alert name.

### Optional

- `agent_ids` (Set of String) Agent IDs to which the alert is restricted. Set [] to remove the restriction.
- `channels` (Dynamic, Sensitive) List of public API notification channel objects. Channel config may contain credentials and is stored as sensitive Terraform state. Set [] for evaluation-only alerts.
- `conversation_source` (String) Conversation source to which the alert applies.
- `cooldown_seconds` (Number) Minimum seconds between triggers.
- `custom_message_template` (String) Optional custom notification message template.
- `description` (String) Alert description.
- `evaluation_type` (String) When the alert evaluates.
- `match_mode` (String) How multiple conditions are combined.
- `required_tags` (Set of String) Tags that matching runs must contain. Set [] to remove the restriction.
- `scheduled_run_ids` (Set of String) Scheduled-run IDs to which the alert is restricted. Set [] to remove the restriction.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that owns this resource. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned alert ULID.
- `last_triggered_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest trigger when available.
- `status` (String) Alert status.
- `trigger_count` (Number) Number of times the alert has triggered.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = coval_alert.low_resolution
  identity = {
    id = "01HZ0EXAMPLE00000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

#### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String)

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coval_alert.low_resolution 01HZ0EXAMPLE00000000000000
```
